inputs: Deterministic gzip files containing only original normals, subset/type data, exact comparison constants and ambient rational fields.
index_method: Gcd of every maximal minor, with exact dependent rank and full image inclusion under an explicit admissible Gram permutation.
recurrence_method: Reverse subset adjoint elimination with integer-scaled Todd polynomials, complete finite numerators, every proper face, and all Bernoulli terms through degree six.
field_method: Exact ambient kernel equations and every original row using index(I)/index(J), including all omitted zero supports.
completion_marker: Only a valid atomically published COMPLETE.json record certifies successful full verification; malformed marker bytes in hostile fixtures do not count as publication.
binary_cache: Built freshly from checked mathematical data; local to the compiler ABI and verification run.
completion_publication: Serialize first; write an exclusive same-directory temporary; flush and close; atomically rename only the complete record. Failed staging is retained and cannot suppress abort evidence.
finalization_controls: Serialization, partial-write and rename failures; malformed existing markers; normal publication; INT/TERM/HUP/QUIT after partial temporary writing.
